annotations.title: Live fuel prices at the pump

description: Use this when a user asks the current price of petrol, diesel, E10, E85, LPG or CNG near a place in Brazil, Canada, Spain, the EU (national averages), France, the United Kingdom (national averages), Italy, Mexico, Malaysia, New Zealand, Taiwan or the United States, or where fuel is cheapest there. Returns the median and typical range of pump prices across stations in the area, the three cheapest stations, and the official source and licence. How fresh: Brazil: ANP publishes the survey as one file per month, so the newest survey week is usually one to four weeks old. Our copy is refreshed daily, and every answer states the survey week it describes; Canada: monthly, not live: Statistics Canada publishes each month's averages about two weeks after the month ends (August 2026 was released on 14 September 2026), and every answer states its reference month; Spain: several times a day; the EU (national averages): weekly: Monday prices, published that week; France: about every 10 minutes; the United Kingdom (national averages): weekly: one national figure each week, usually available the same week; Italy: daily (prices at 08:00 of the extraction day); Mexico: the feeds are current prices reported by the stations and carry no timestamps; our copy is taken once a day and every answer shows the day of that copy; Malaysia: weekly, on Thursdays; New Zealand: weekly (Fridays), using the previous week's data; the newest weeks are marked Provisional by MBIE and revised; Taiwan: changes usually on Mondays; the next week's list price is published the day before; the United States: weekly: EIA dates each figure to the Monday it describes and publishes it a day or two later (a day later after a federal holiday); our copy of EIA's history files is refreshed daily and every answer states its week. Do not use for other countries or for historical prices.

area.description: Wider area when no postcode. BR: state as a two-letter code or name ('SP', 'Minas Gerais'); leave empty for all Brazil. Canada: same as town (a city, or 'Canada'). Provinces are not published. ES: province code ('28' = Madrid). EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used (national average only). FR: department ('69', '2A'). GB: not used (national average only). IT: province ('MI', 'RM'). MX: state name or code ('Ciudad de México', 'CDMX', 'Jalisco', 'NLE'); leave empty for all Mexico. Only states are available. MY: not used (national price only). NZ: not used (national price only). TW: not used (island-wide price only). US: a state ('TX', 'California') or PADD region ('Gulf Coast', 'PADD 1B', 'West Coast'); leave empty for the national average. EIA publishes gasoline for CA, CO, FL, MA, MN, NY, OH, TX and WA, diesel only for California plus the nation and PADD regions. Any other place gets the national average, and the answer says so (with its region as context).

country.description: BR = Brazil (ANP weekly survey: regular petrol and diesel S10); CA = Canada (Statistics Canada: monthly average retail price by city, official statistic, not a live pump price); ES = Spain; EU Weekly Oil Bulletin, national average pump prices: IE = Ireland, DE = Germany, NL = the Netherlands, BE = Belgium, PT = Portugal, PL = Poland, DK = Denmark, SE = Sweden, FI = Finland, LU = Luxembourg, GR = Greece, CZ = Czechia, SK = Slovakia, SI = Slovenia, HR = Croatia, HU = Hungary, RO = Romania, BG = Bulgaria, EE = Estonia, LV = Latvia, LT = Lithuania, CY = Cyprus, MT = Malta; FR = France; GB = United Kingdom (DESNZ weekly national average pump prices of unleaded petrol and diesel); IT = Italy; MX = Mexico (by state); MY = Malaysia (weekly government-set national price; an official published price, not a station price); NZ = New Zealand (MBIE weekly national average retail price; an official statistic, not a station price); TW = Taiwan (posted island-wide list price of CPC Corporation; a posted price, not a station price); US = United States (U.S. Energy Information Administration: weekly average retail gasoline and diesel prices in US$ per gallon for the nation, PADD regions, 9 states and 10 cities)

fuel.description: petrol95 = unleaded 95; methane = CNG (priced per kg). Brazil: petrol95 = regular petrol (gasolina comum, not RON 95) or diesel (= diesel S10). Other fuels are not covered. Canada: petrol95 = regular unleaded gasoline (87 AKI, about 91 RON), petrol98 = premium unleaded, diesel; self-service stations. E10, E85, LPG and CNG are not published. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: petrol95 (Euro-super 95), diesel (automotive gas oil) or lpg, as a national average per litre in euro with all taxes; heating gas oil is in the extra fields. Other fuels are not published. GB: petrol95 (unleaded petrol, ULSP) or diesel (ULSD) only, as a national average in pounds per litre; other fuels are not published. Italy: diesel, petrol95, lpg, methane only. Mexico: petrol95 = regular petrol (gasolina regular, Magna), petrol98 = premium petrol, or diesel. Mexican grades are not 95 or 98 RON. MY: diesel, petrol95 (RON95, unsubsidised rate) or petrol98 (answered with RON97). Subsidised BUDI95/SKPS/SKDS prices are in extra.subsidised_myr_per_litre. NZ: diesel, or petrol95 (MBIE's Premium Petrol 95R; petrol98 gets the same series). Regular petrol 91 is returned in extra.other_fuels. TW: diesel (premium diesel), petrol95 (95 unleaded) or petrol98 (98 unleaded), in NT$ per litre with VAT and excise. 92 unleaded and 95E3 gasohol are in the extra fields. US: petrol95 = regular gasoline, petrol98 = premium gasoline, diesel = on-highway diesel (all types). For midgrade gasoline use petrol95 with gasoline_grade=midgrade. Prices are weekly averages in US dollars per gallon, taxes included (US$ per litre is in extra). EIA publishes no E10, E85, LPG or CNG prices.

gasoline_grade.description: US only: the gasoline grade EIA publishes. Overrides the grade implied by fuel (petrol95 = regular, petrol98 = premium); use midgrade here with fuel=petrol95. Not for diesel.

postcode.description: Postcode of the place. BR: not used (the survey is published by state and municipality). Canada: not used. ES: 5-digit postcode, e.g. '28001'. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used; the bulletin publishes one national average per country, so the national figure is returned and says so. FR: 5-digit postcode, e.g. '75015'. GB: not used; DESNZ publishes one UK average, so the national figure is returned and says so. MX: not used. MY: not used (national price only). NZ: not used (national price only). TW: not used (island-wide price only). US: not used (EIA publishes no ZIP-code prices).

service.description: Self-service or attended service, where a country prices them differently. Canada: self only. Full-service prices stopped in 2013. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used. GB: not used. IT: self-service (default) or attended service, which costs more. MY: not used. NZ: not used. TW: not used. US: not used.

town.description: Town name. BR: municipality, e.g. 'São Paulo' or 'Curitiba'; add area when the name exists in several states. Canada: one of the 18 cities Statistics Canada tracks (St. John's, Charlottetown and Summerside, Halifax, Saint John, Québec, Montréal, Ottawa-Gatineau, Toronto, Thunder Bay, Winnipeg, Regina, Saskatoon, Edmonton, Calgary, Vancouver, Victoria, Whitehorse, Yellowknife), or 'Canada' for the national average (regular unleaded only). Leave town and area out for the national average. ES: town name, e.g. 'Valencia'. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used (national average only). GB: not used (national average only). IT: comune name, e.g. 'Bologna'. MX: not used for cities; a state name given here works like area. MY: not used. One national price per week; any place is answered with the Malaysia price and the answer says so. NZ: not used. MBIE publishes one national price per week; any place is answered with the New Zealand average and the answer says so. TW: not used. CPC posts one island-wide price; any place is answered with the Taiwan price and the answer says so. US: one of the ten cities EIA publishes (Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York City, San Francisco, Seattle), gasoline only; otherwise the national average is returned and the answer says so.

name: pricepaid_fuel_prices_now

outputSchema.description: A price answer: a range or an official statistic with sample size, period, confidence, source and licence.

answer_id.description: Audit trail: a stable id (hash of source id, normalised query, data period and method_version). The same question on the same data gives the same id; keep it with the reasoning that used the figure.

as_of.description: When the answer was produced (ISO 8601); the snapshot date when the official source was down and the answer comes from our copy.

data_age_days.description: Whole days between data_as_of and retrieved_at; null when data_as_of is null.

data_as_of.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the newest data point behind the figure; null when unknown.

evidence.description: Audit trail: what kind of evidence the figure is.

label.description: Short name of the kind of evidence, e.g. 'Recorded sale prices', 'Official published average', 'Posted shelf or pump price', 'Contract award value', 'Regulated reimbursement price'.

meaning.description: One sentence on what this kind of evidence does and does not establish.

extra.description: Source-specific details (for example cheapest stations). extra.stale is true when the answer comes from our copy of the source.

method_version.description: Audit trail: version of the way this source turns raw data into an answer (per source, default '1').

notice.description: Information, not a valuation or offer. Also says when the answer is our copy because the official source did not respond.

period.description: The period the records cover (ISO dates), or the date of the snapshot when the answer comes from our copy.

anyOf.description: The price. Null when there is not enough data to publish a figure (fewer than 5 records) or nothing matched.

measure.description: What value is: median for ranges built from records; average or median for official statistics.

typical_high.description: 90th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

typical_low.description: 10th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

unit.description: What the price is per, e.g. 'per litre', 'per home', 'per kWh'.

value.description: The headline figure. For ranges built from records it equals median.

price_type.description: transaction, posted_pump_price, posted_price, contract_price, reimbursement_price or official_statistic.

query.description: The request as understood, echoed back.

reliability.description: How far to trust the figure as a distribution of real prices. official_with_count = a published official figure with a record count; official_median_no_count = a published average or median with no record count (confidence 'high' there means the publisher is official, not that a count was checked); record_level = 15+ records we hold; thin = 5–14 records; stale = our copy because the official source did not respond; insufficient_data = no figure published.

retrieved_at.description: Audit trail: when ProofPrice produced this answer (ISO 8601). For an answer from our own copy this is now, while as_of is the snapshot date.

sample_size.description: Number of records behind the figure; null when the publisher does not say.

source.description: Where the figure comes from, under which licence, and the attribution line to show.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show with the figure.

url.description: The publisher's page for this data.

statistic.description: Official statistics only: what kind of figure it is and the period the publisher states it for.

status.description: ok = a figure is returned; insufficient_data = fewer than 5 matching records; no_matches = nothing matched.

suggestions.description: Short plain things to try next: widen the period or area, ask for an itemised quote. May be empty.

summary.description: One plain sentence an AI can quote.

title: Live fuel prices at the pump
